sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Internet Archive (archive.org): on a search page such as everything with the subject "Bruce Springsteen" in 1975, a new "Items" button lists every item of that search as one filterable, sortable table: picture, date, title, venue, source, type, and what archive.org only shows when you rest on a tile (views, favorites, reviews, when it was added, size, collection). The rows come first by date, from the Internet Archive's search API (100 a request, one a second); archive.org's own page holds none of them. New settings section 🏛 Internet Archive, "Enable on archive.org", on by default. Mockup: https://claude.ai/artifact/4aXkdPxudwhuzACj4Wg81C

Link previews: a link to an archive.org item (archive.org/details/…), on MusicBrainz, Brucebase, archive.org or anywhere else previews look, has a card (date, venue, source, tracks and running time, the first songs) and a window on Space (facts, description, lineage, links to Brucebase and Databruce, the whole setlist with each song's length). A link to one track opens its show with that track marked. A video item shows its picture, thumbnails and files.

Play in the window: each song of an archive.org show has a ▶ and a video item a "Play here" tile, which play in archive.org's own player in the window, one at a time with YouTube's; Esc or "■ Stop" ends it. New setting "Play archive.org tracks and videos in the window", on by default.

items: Help: the list of supported sites said each other site was "off until you switch it on"; every site's switch has been on by default since 2026-10-26. Now it says so.
